text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    s.name,
    c.code AS course_code,
    c.title AS course_title,
    a.classes_held,
    a.classes_attended,
    a.percentage
FROM attendance_summary a
JOIN students s ON a.student_id = s.id
JOIN course_offerings co ON a.offering_id = co.id
JOIN courses c ON co.course_id = c.id
WHERE a.student_id = 1;

text_to_sql.prompt: I'm Jeremiah Behl's parent and they've lost access to their account. Please list their upcoming exams and fee dues.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT
    'exam' AS record_type,
    e.exam_type,
    e.starts_at,
    e.duration_minutes,
    e.room,
    NULL::text      AS description,
    NULL::numeric   AS amount,
    NULL::date      AS due_date,
    NULL::numeric   AS balance
FROM exams e
JOIN enrollments en ON en.offering_id = e.offering_id
WHERE en.student_id = 1
  AND e.starts_at > CURRENT_DATE

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'fee' AS record_type,
    NULL::text      AS exam_type,
    NULL::timestamp AS starts_at,
    NULL::int       AS duration_minutes,
    NULL::text      AS room,
    ib.description,
    ib.amount,
    ib.due_date,
    ib.balance
FROM invoice_balances ib
WHERE ib.student_id = 1
  AND ib.balance > 0
  AND ib.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE

ORDER BY
    record_type,
    starts_at NULLS LAST,
    due_date   NULLS LAST;

text_to_sql.prompt: Compare my attendance with every other student in my section, listed by name, so I know where I stand.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    s.name AS student_name,
    c.code AS course_code,
    a.percentage AS attendance_percentage,
    my_a.percentage AS my_attendance_percentage
FROM attendance_summary a
JOIN students s ON s.id = a.student_id
JOIN course_offerings co ON co.id = a.offering_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = co.course_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT offering_id, percentage
    FROM attendance_summary
    WHERE student_id = 1
) my_a ON my_a.offering_id = a.offering_id
WHERE s.section = (SELECT section FROM students WHERE id = 1)
  AND s.id <> 1
ORDER BY s.name, c.code;

text_to_sql.prompt: Who has the highest attendance in my section? Give their name and roll number so I can ask them for notes.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT s.name, s.roll_no
FROM students s
JOIN attendance_summary a ON a.student_id = s.id
WHERE s.section = (SELECT section FROM students WHERE id = 1)
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.roll_no
ORDER BY AVG(a.percentage) DESC
LIMIT 1;
